name: The Vealth Standard
also_known_as: the EcoWealth Standard — same standard; the operator named the family EcoWealth (2026-08-07) and its public name Vealth (2026-08-10)
subtitle: A standard for the place already standing.
authored_from: Operator direction 2026-08-06: forge our own standard between Michelin, LBC/ILFI and the SDGs, aimed at renovating what already stands rather than certifying what does not exist yet.
one_line: A place holds Standing while the work keeps happening, measured by what changed, carried by the people who did it, and readable in the world's own vocabulary.
what_it_is_not: Not a certification. There is no committee, no application, no fee, and no plaque.
Not a design target. Nothing here can be earned on paper before the work is done.

Not a replacement for the Living Building Challenge, the Michelin Guide, or the Sustainable Development Goals. It is the maintenance layer under them, and every condition names exactly which of theirs it serves.

why_it_exists.problem: The three standards we run our ladders on are excellent and all three are pointed somewhere else. The Living Building Challenge measures a project on a site. The Michelin Guide judges a kitchen, not a building. The Sustainable Development Goals speak to nations. None of them has a unit for the thing that most needs the work: a building that is already standing, already occupied, already degrading, with nobody measuring it.
why_it_exists.answer: Make the unit a bounded piece of work with a receipt, and make the status something a place holds only while that work keeps happening.

objections_answered.certification_is_not_the_goal: held_not_awarded and start_where_it_is. Nothing here rewards a new project. A place enters at whatever state it is in.
objections_answered.lbc_imperative_17_is_unreachable_downtow: LBC Universal Access assumes a project on a site with sky around it, and in a dense core that shadow was cast decades ago. The condition everyone_can_get_here re-points the same intent at the street that exists: can a person using a wheelchair, a cane, or a stroller reach this place and use it. That is measurable on any block in Los Angeles or New York today.
objections_answered.lbc_imperative_18_does_not_reach_the_lab: LBC Inclusion verifies a contract percentage. It never touches the person. rung_at_the_ground and receipt_is_the_certificate verify the person directly: a named steward, a settled wage, on a record nobody can quietly edit.

the_unit.name: Standing
place_can_be: a stretch of creek, shoreline, or street
the_unit.computed_from: settled work packets with accepted proof on the EcoWealth board. Nothing else counts toward a standing.
the_unit.default_applicability: All nine conditions apply to a place unless the place records a condition as not applicable with a stated reason. A recorded exemption is public and can be challenged.

laws.name: Standing is held, not awarded.
laws.text: A standing is a live status, not an achievement. It is re-measured on a cadence and it lapses when the work stops or a condition trends down. The Michelin Guide can take a star back and the Living Building Challenge demands twelve months of real occupied performance. This law puts both of those on maintenance, which is where the degradation actually happens.
laws.enforced_by: The lapse rule in the standings table. A place that stops measuring falls to the highest level it still satisfies.

laws.name: The receipt is the certificate.
laws.text: There is no committee, no application, no fee, and no site visit by a body you have to pay. A bounded work packet, evidence before and after, a named steward, a settled wage, and an entry on a record nobody can quietly edit. That is the whole apparatus. If a claim has no receipt behind it, the claim does not exist.
laws.enforced_by: Standings compute only from settled packets with accepted proof. Unsettled, unproven, or self-attested work contributes nothing.

laws.name: Every condition has a rung at the ground.
laws.text: Every one of the nine conditions must be enterable today by a person with no license, no capital, and no specialized equipment. If a condition cannot be entered that way, the condition is written wrong, not the person. This is the working answer to inclusion: not a percentage of a contract, but a ladder with a rung on the floor.
laws.enforced_by: Each condition carries a ground_rung that names the tools, the time, and what the person walks away with. A condition without a valid ground rung is not admissible in this standard.

laws.name: Start where it is.
laws.text: No clear site, no new build, no budget floor, no minimum condition of entry. A place enters filthy, drafty, cracked, and unmeasured, and that entry is honorable. It is a dirty old world and meeting it as it is is the point.
laws.enforced_by: The Unread standing is a real, named, non-failing state. Nearly every place on earth is in it.

laws.name: Nobody is hurt earning it.
laws.text: A standing built on injured hands is void. Every packet carries its hazard and its control, and every ground rung is one a person can do without specialized protection. Safety work is not a condition of the place. It is the condition on which any of this counts at all.
laws.enforced_by: Packets that map to this law are hazard controls, not conditions. They gate the work rather than scoring the place.

sdg: 8.8 protect labour rights and promote safe and secure working environments

standings.name: Unread
standings.plain: Nobody has measured it. This is where nearly every place on earth is, and it is not a failure.
standings.computable_rule: no settled measurement packet on any applicable condition

standings.name: Read
standings.plain: The place has been honestly measured and its gaps are named on the record.
standings.requires: one settled measurement packet on every applicable condition
standings.computable_rule: for every applicable condition: count(settled packets of kind=measure with accepted proof) >= 1

standings.name: Tended
standings.plain: The first repairs landed, with before and after evidence, and one of them was checked again a season later.
standings.requires: Read, plus a settled repair showing an improving delta on at least five conditions, plus at least one re-measure taken 90 or more days after its first measure
standings.computable_rule: read AND count(conditions with >=1 settled kind=repair packet carrying an improving delta) >= 5 AND count(conditions with a re-measure >= 90 days after first measure) >= 1

standings.name: Kept
standings.plain: A maintenance cadence is running. Everything gets looked at twice a year and nothing is sliding backward.
standings.requires: every applicable condition measured at least twice in the last twelve months, no condition's latest measure worse than the one before it, and at least one settled repair in the last twelve months
standings.computable_rule: for every applicable condition: count(settled measures in trailing 365d) >= 2 AND latest_measure not worse than previous; AND count(settled repairs in trailing 365d) >= 1

standings.name: Whole
standings.plain: Twelve straight months of measured performance across every applicable condition, nothing trending down, and the place has taught somebody. A person who worked here moved up a rung doing it.
standings.requires: Kept held continuously for twelve months across every applicable condition, no condition trending down, and at least one steward whose skill level advanced on packets settled at this place
standings.computable_rule: kept held for 12 consecutive months across all applicable conditions AND no condition trending down AND count(distinct stewards with a skill_level advance on packets settled at this place) >= 1

lapse_rule: A standing above Read lapses immediately to the highest level still satisfied when a required re-measure is missed or any condition's latest measure is worse than the one before it. Lapsing is normal, is public, and is not a penalty. It is the standard doing its job.

cadence_policy.why: The lapse rule was prose only until 2026-08-26: every condition stated its cadence in words ('hold') and its failure in words ('fails_when'), and nothing on any rail read a clock. These two numbers are the machine-readable half of the same two sentences, so a lapse is computed rather than asserted.
cadence_policy.remeasure_cadence_days: How often the condition is due to be looked at again. Read straight off that condition's own 'hold' sentence. Passing it makes the condition DUE, which is a prompt, not a lapse.
cadence_policy.lapse_after_days: How long the condition may go unmeasured before its coverage lapses. Read straight off that condition's own 'fails_when' sentence, which is deliberately more forgiving than the cadence in several conditions.

derivation.shelter_holds: hold 'each season' = 90 · fails_when 'a season passes with no walk' = 90
derivation.air_is_clean: hold 'twice a year' = 182 · fails_when 'a year passes with no reading' = 365
derivation.water_is_honest: hold 'twice a year' = 182 · fails_when 'six months pass with no read' = 182
derivation.power_is_earned: hold 'monthly' = 30 · fails_when 'two consecutive months are missed', so the last read is three monthly slots old = 90
derivation.nothing_leaves_as_waste: hold 'twice a year' = 182 · fails_when 'six months pass with no weigh' = 182
derivation.the_ground_is_alive: hold 'twice a year' = 182 · fails_when 'a year passes with no count' = 365
derivation.a_person_is_fed_well: hold 'each season' = 90 · fails_when 'a season passes with no record' = 90
derivation.everyone_can_get_here: hold 'twice a year' = 182 · fails_when 'six months pass with no walk' = 182
derivation.the_commons_is_kept: hold 'monthly' = 30 · fails_when 'a month passes with no walk' = 30

cadence_policy.what_it_does_not_do: Neither number is a worsening-delta rule. Every condition's 'fails_when' also lapses on a number that got worse, and the receipts do not carry comparable measurements yet, so only the missed-re-measure half of the lapse rule is computed today. The other half stays named and uncomputed rather than approximated.
cadence_policy.unknown_age_never_lapses: A packet whose proof and settlement carry no timestamp has an unknown age. Unknown age is never treated as a lapse, because a lapse we cannot date is a lapse we cannot prove.

conditions.name: Shelter holds
conditions.sentence: Weather stays out and conditioned air stays in.
conditions.why: The cheapest, least glamorous win in the entire built world. A sealed gap pays back forever and anyone can find one with a lit stick of incense.
measures: count of air leaks found, and of those, how many sealed
drafts still detectable at door, window, sill and penetration
envelope defects open versus closed (roof, gutter, glazing, masonry, foundation)

ground_rung.title: Walk the place and find every draft
ground_rung.tools: a lit incense stick or a damp hand, a phone camera, a pen
ground_rung.output: a photographed, counted list of every air leak, and at least one of them sealed

conditions.fails_when: a season passes with no walk, or the leak count goes up

sdg: 7.3 double the rate of improvement in energy efficiency

conditions.name: The air is clean
conditions.sentence: You breathe better inside than out.
conditions.why: People spend most of their lives indoors and almost nobody has ever measured the air they sleep in. A thirty dollar meter turns an assumption into a number.
measures: carbon dioxide in parts per million at peak occupancy in the most used room
fine particulate indoors compared to outdoors
visible mold and moisture, found and remediated
known hazardous materials identified and swapped out

ground_rung.title: Read the air in the room you use most
ground_rung.tools: a low cost carbon dioxide meter, a pen
ground_rung.output: the peak reading, the time it happened, and what was open or closed when it did

instruments: lab assay for lead, radon or asbestos at mastery
conditions.hold: re-read twice a year and after any renovation
conditions.fails_when: a year passes with no reading, or the peak reading rises

michelin: a kitchen a cook can work a full service in
sdg: 3.9 reduce deaths and illnesses from hazardous chemicals and air pollution
11.6 reduce the adverse per capita environmental impact of cities

conditions.name: The water is honest
conditions.sentence: It arrives clean, is used carefully, and leaves cleaner than it came.
conditions.why: Every fixture in a building is a number nobody has written down, and a running toilet outspends a solar panel.
measures: gallons per minute at every fixture
leaks found and stopped, and the gallons per day they were costing
drinking water tested against the contaminants that actually occur here
rain that infiltrates on the parcel versus rain that runs to the drain

ground_rung.title: Bucket and stopwatch every tap in the place
ground_rung.tools: a marked bucket, a phone stopwatch, a pen
ground_rung.output: the gallons per minute of every fixture, and every leak found written down with the drip rate

instruments: water meter read with everything off
conditions.fails_when: six months pass with no read, a stopped leak reappears, or a fixture's flow goes up

sdg: 6.3 improve water quality by reducing pollution

conditions.name: The power is earned
conditions.sentence: The place uses less than it did, and makes what it can.
conditions.why: Efficiency first, then generation. A photograph of the meter on the same day each month is a full year of proof that costs nothing.
measures: kilowatt hours this month against the same month last year
kilowatt hours generated on site
what the place still burns on site, and what replaced it

ground_rung.title: Photograph the meter on the same day every month
ground_rung.output: a dated series of meter photographs that nobody can argue with

conditions.hold: read monthly, compared year over year
conditions.fails_when: two consecutive months are missed, or use rises year over year with no stated reason

sdg: 7.2 increase the share of renewable energy
7.3 double the rate of improvement in energy efficiency

conditions.name: Nothing leaves as waste
conditions.sentence: What comes out of here has a next use.
conditions.why: This is the one condition the Michelin Green Star already teaches better than anyone. A zero waste kitchen looks at a carrot top and sees stock. The same eye works on a demolition pile.
measures: pounds diverted against pounds landfilled
the named next use for each stream leaving the place
material recovered from repair and demolition instead of dumped

ground_rung.title: Weigh one week of what leaves
ground_rung.tools: a bathroom scale, bags, a pen
ground_rung.time: one week, a few minutes a day
ground_rung.output: pounds by stream, and a named next use for each pile that has one

conditions.fails_when: the landfilled share rises, or six months pass with no weigh

michelin: Green Star, zero waste kitchen practice
sdg: 12.5 substantially reduce waste generation through prevention, reduction, recycling and reuse

conditions.name: The ground is alive
conditions.sentence: The soil, the water, the canopy and the small lives on this ground and its street are trending up.
conditions.why: Everything else on this list is about a structure. This one is about the living matrix the structure sits in, including the creek four blocks away that the parcel drains into.
measures: trees standing, tree wells empty, canopy over the parcel and its street
permeable ground against sealed ground
soil that takes water, and what is living in it
species seen, counted the same way each time
the condition of the nearest living water

ground_rung.title: Count the trees and the empty tree wells on your block
ground_rung.output: a photographed count of every tree and every empty well, with its location

instruments: soil infiltration test with a coffee can
bioassessment and soil carbon sampling at mastery
conditions.hold: re-counted twice a year, in the same season each time
conditions.fails_when: canopy or species count falls, permeable ground is lost, or a year passes with no count

sdg: 15.1 conserve and restore terrestrial and freshwater ecosystems
11.7 access to safe, inclusive green spaces

conditions.name: A person is fed well here
conditions.sentence: The place can nourish someone to craft standard, from as close as it can get.
conditions.why: This is Michelin's entire contribution and it is the one the other two standards have no language for. A building that cannot feed anyone is not finished.
measures: meals made here, and how far each ingredient travelled
growing ground on or near the parcel that is actually producing
a kitchen that works: stocked, safe, and able to run a service
food preserved rather than lost

ground_rung.title: Cook one meal and write down where every ingredient came from
ground_rung.output: the dish, and the provenance of every component including the honest ones that came from a truck

instruments: a thermometer and a log for preservation
conditions.hold: re-recorded each season, because the season is what changes
conditions.fails_when: the growing ground stops producing, the kitchen stops working, or a season passes with no record

michelin: the personality of the cook in the cooking

conditions.name: Everyone can get here
conditions.sentence: A person using a wheelchair, a cane, a stroller, or nothing at all can reach this place and use it.
conditions.why: This is Living Building Challenge Imperative 17 taken off the empty site and put on the street that already exists. The shadow rule assumes sky around the project. Downtown, that shadow was cast decades ago. The curb ramp on the corner is not hypothetical and it is either at grade or it is not.
measures: curb ramps present and at grade on every corner of the approach
path width, running slope, cross slope
trip hazards, counted and closed
lighting at night, and sightlines
working handrails wherever there is a step

ground_rung.title: Take a tape and a level down your own block
ground_rung.tools: a tape measure, a phone level app, a phone camera
ground_rung.output: a photographed log of every trip hazard, missing ramp, blocked path and dead light on the block

instruments: a night walk with the camera
a wheelchair or stroller walkthrough with the person who uses one, at mastery
conditions.hold: re-walked twice a year and after any street work
conditions.fails_when: a new hazard appears and stays, a light stays dead, or six months pass with no walk

lbc: Imperative 17 Universal Access, re-pointed at the existing street rather than the project site
Imperative 18 Inclusion, verified per person through the receipt rather than per contract percentage
sdg: 11.2 safe, accessible and sustainable transport systems for all
11.7 universal access to safe and inclusive public spaces
10.2 empower and promote inclusion of all

conditions.name: The commons is kept
conditions.sentence: The shared ground here is sound and clean, nothing broken is left broken, and what was done is legible to the next person.
conditions.why: The Living Building Challenge calls this Beauty and Education, and the Michelin Guide calls it consistency. Both mean the same thing: a place shows whether anyone is looking after it. Ordinary upkeep of the shared surface is the most visible signal a neighbourhood has, and it is almost entirely unfunded.
measures: open defects against closed defects on the shared surface
days from a defect being logged to being fixed
the upkeep cadence, held or missed
whether the record of what was done here can be read by the next person

ground_rung.title: Walk your block and log every broken, tagged, or dumped thing
ground_rung.output: a photographed list of every defect on the shared ground, and the smallest one fixed

instruments: a maintenance calendar that is actually kept
conditions.hold: re-walked monthly, because this one degrades fastest
conditions.fails_when: the open defect count rises, days to repair grows, or a month passes with no walk

michelin: consistency between visits and across the menu, which is the same discipline applied to a place instead of a plate
sdg: 11.6 reduce the adverse environmental impact of cities

conditions.name: The creatures are well
conditions.sentence: The animals who share this place are sound, fed, and free from avoidable pain.
conditions.why: A limping cow, a hive losing its brood to mites, a dog that quietly stopped jumping onto the couch: every one of these is measurable for weeks or months before anyone calls it an emergency. The person who feeds the animal daily is the one positioned to catch it, and they have never been handed a scorecard.
conditions.applies_when: the place keeps or hosts animals. Scored only once a creature packet has settled here, so a place with no animals is never held to it. This is the standings' own "every applicable condition" wording, implemented for the first time (2026-08-30).
measures: body condition scored on the published scale for the species
mobility or lameness scored on a walk, the same way every time
pain and welfare screened against a named protocol rather than a hunch
colony, hive and flock health counted rather than estimated

ground_rung.title: Body-condition score every animal in your care, on the published scale
ground_rung.tools: the species' published score card, your hands, a pen
ground_rung.time: under an hour for a household or a small herd
ground_rung.output: a dated body-condition score for every animal, with the ribs-and-spine notes that produced it

instruments: a walk-past mobility or gait score
a FAMACHA card for small ruminants
an alcohol or sugar wash for varroa in a hive
conditions.fails_when: a quarter passes with no score, a score drops and nobody acted, or a referral flag was raised and never followed

law_bound.note: Hazard controls, not conditions of a place. They gate how work is done. They score nothing and they are required by everything.

Work that makes the record true rather than changing a place. Reading an authoritative indicator at its source, checking a citation actually says what it is cited for, keeping a public record reachable, resolving a species name against the taxonomic backbone, rolling up measurement into a quantification. None of it moves a condition. All of it is why a condition's number can be believed.
Work that puts the rung within reach of a person who could not otherwise take it. Translating a packet into the language the worker actually reads is not a nicety here, it is the law being enforced.

Intake. Somebody walks a block that nobody has ever measured and writes down what is wrong with it. This scores no condition because at intake there is not yet a condition to score. It is how a place stops being Unread, and it is the single most common piece of work in the whole library.

cross_cutting_ids.note: The institutional twin of sdg_community_needs, carrying the same honest-bucket rule. Only the intake work_type was remapped here (2026-08-14), because only intake had civic-venue definitions reading a household-voiced method; the food, waste and commons work_types stay on sdg_community_needs where their own conditions already hold them. Every work_type must be listed. There is deliberately no default.

An honest bucket rather than a subject. These packets share one standard id but do different things: most are intake, and the rest are dumping, litter, food access and compost work that belong to real conditions. Resolved by work_type rather than forced into one home, because forcing it would put a food pantry build under waste management and make a place's standing a lie. Every work_type must be listed. There is deliberately no default.

out_of_scope_v0.note: Named honestly rather than force-fitted. The Vealth Standard is a standard for a place. A person's body is not a property of a place, and those standards belong to the health protocol; a Person track is v1 territory and it is not written yet, so nothing here pretends to cover it. The animals of a place ARE a property of it, which is why 'the creatures are well' was added as the tenth condition (2026-08-30) rather than pushed out of scope alongside the human libraries. 2026-09-04 crosswalk (the care-and-hospitality frontier's item 17): of the frontier's five named axes (workers well, food real, nights quiet, families hosted, isolated visited), only two are properties of the PLACE rather than of a person's body or experience — hazard controls on how lifting and heat exposure are managed (niosh_lifting_equation, occupational_heat_stress -> law:nobody_is_hurt, same class as heat_illness_prevention) and the place's own capacity to feed someone real food (ward_mealtime_hosting, medically_tailored_meal_with_company, regenerative_food_procurement, community_dinner_hosting -> condition:a_person_is_fed_well, the same home michelin_ingredient_provenance already holds). Quiet nights (ward_quiet_hours_stewardship), families hosted (caregiver_respite_visit), the isolated visited (companion_visit_social_connection, grief_companionship_first_90_days, hospital_discharge_welcome_home, ward_patient_sitter_companion, welcome_wayfinding_discharge_escort, welcome/wayfinding), a worker's own sleep health and household sleep setup (shift_work_recovery_sleep, shift_worker_sleep_sanctuary), and ward cleanliness (environmental_hygiene_verification) stay correctly out of scope: each one scores a person's experience or a worker's own body/home, not the building, and no default bucket was invented to force them in. This is the standard's own scope law holding, not a gap left by this increment. 2026-09-05 addition (the regenerative-motion course, unit 9, the protocol's next workers): two more health-care standards join the declared place properties, on the same test and for the same reason. ward_mobility_path_walkthrough measures a corridor's clear width, a handrail's continuity, a floor transition and a light level at the floor, every one of which belongs to the building, so it is homed at condition:everyone_can_get_here beside the curb ramps, trip hazards and dead lights already there; it assesses no person's fall risk, which stays a clinical judgment the facility's own staff make. care_kitchen_service_readiness measures whether the facility's own kitchen can run the diets already ordered, which is the capacity condition:a_person_is_fed_well already names in its own measures ('a kitchen that works: stocked, safe, and able to run a service'), so it lands there beside the four food standards homed on 2026-09-04. Both are hands-on care labor rather than clinical measurement, so neither belongs in the method-coverage lane exemption: each carries a full method in the health sidecar and reaches the board's own registry through programs:merge-methods. Nothing else moved, and the rest of the care lane stays out of scope on the same test that kept it there.
out_of_scope_v0.match_rule: any standard id present in the health work library and in no condition list above; the ids in homed_place_properties are the declared exceptions (properties of the PLACE, argued in the note), each with exactly one home, and check:science-kingdoms-scope refuses any other homed health standard

unmapped_policy.rule: Every standard id used by a shipped work library must map to exactly one condition, to the nobody_is_hurt law, or to the declared out_of_scope_v0 set. An unmapped id is a build failure, not a warning.
unmapped_policy.why: A standard that quietly tolerates work it cannot classify is a standard with a hole in it. New work either lands in a condition or forces the standard to be extended on purpose.

generosity_note: This standard takes from three excellent instruments and points them at a target none of them was built for. The Living Building Challenge is the reason measured performance over real occupied time is non negotiable here. The Michelin Guide is the reason a standing can be lost and the reason craft has its own condition. The Sustainable Development Goals are the reason every condition carries targets a stranger in another country can already read. Nothing here is a criticism of any of them. They point at the building that does not exist yet. This one points at the building you are sitting in.
